messages.plugin.name: PostgreSQL Database Adapter
messages.plugin.description: Connects to administrator-provisioned PostgreSQL, safely migrates the canonical database, and exposes credential-free capabilities.
messages.plugin.sidebar.label: PostgreSQL Adapter
messages.ui.connectionTargetHelp: Connect to a PostgreSQL server. By default, OpenConcept checks pgvector for Standard RAG and enables the vector extension when it is available. OpenConcept does not install PostgreSQL or pgvector server files.
messages.ui.pdoPgsqlRequirement: Important: To use PostgreSQL, enable extension=pdo_pgsql in the php.ini used by the PHP runtime that runs OpenConcept. Connections and migrations will not work while it is disabled.
messages.ui.sourceRequired: PostgreSQL migration requires a healthy SQLite, MySQL, or PostgreSQL canonical backend.
messages.ui.healthStandardRagOk: The canonical database is healthy and pgvector is ready for Standard RAG.
messages.ui.healthDatabaseOnly: The canonical database is healthy, but pgvector is not ready for Standard RAG. Review the guidance above.
messages.ui.standardRagReadyDefault: Make PostgreSQL ready for Standard RAG (recommended)
messages.ui.standardRagReadyDefaultHelp: Before migration, check for the pgvector package, enable the vector extension when available, and verify it. The current canonical database is retained if readiness cannot be established.
messages.ui.postgresqlOnlyAdvanced: Advanced: migrate to PostgreSQL without Standard RAG
messages.ui.postgresqlOnlyAdvancedHelp: Clear the checkbox above to migrate even when pgvector is unavailable. Use this only with Custom RAG or without RAG. Standard RAG remains unavailable until pgvector is prepared.
messages.ui.pgvectorReadyHelp: This canonical PostgreSQL database can store and search vectors for Standard RAG.
messages.ui.pgvectorAvailableHelp: The server has pgvector, but the vector extension is not enabled in this database. Use the action below to enable and recheck it.
messages.ui.pgvectorMissingHelp: PostgreSQL alone does not add vector search. Server files cannot be installed from the browser, so the database server must be prepared first.
messages.ui.pgvectorPermission: Permission is required to enable pgvector
messages.ui.pgvectorPermissionHelp: The pgvector package exists, but the current database user cannot enable the vector extension. Run the operation as the database owner or ask the administrator.
messages.ui.pgvectorActivationFailedHelp: The pgvector package was detected. Check the database extension configuration and server logs, enable it manually, then recheck.
messages.ui.pgvectorNotRequiredHelp: Migration will not require pgvector. OpenConcept Standard RAG will remain unavailable.
messages.ui.pgvectorUnknown: pgvector will be checked on connection
messages.ui.pgvectorUnknownHelp: Before migration, OpenConcept checks the destination package, extension activation, and vector-search capability.
messages.ui.pgvectorMissingStep1: Install pgvector for the PostgreSQL major version on the database server, including vector.control and the shared library.
messages.ui.pgvectorMissingStep2: Have the database administrator confirm that vector appears in pg_available_extensions.
messages.ui.pgvectorMissingStep3: Return here and run the connection or health check again.
messages.ui.pgvectorManualAction: To enable it manually as the database owner:
messages.ui.enablingPgvector: Enabling and checking the vector extension…
messages.ui.pgvectorEnabled: pgvector is enabled. Standard RAG is now available.
messages.ui.postgresqlReplacementWarning: This replaces the current canonical PostgreSQL endpoint with another PostgreSQL database. The old database is retained but is not synchronized after cutover.
messages.ui.postgresqlReplacementConfirm: Replace the current canonical PostgreSQL database with the specified PostgreSQL destination?
messages.ui.copyCanonicalHelp: Copies all canonical Core and plugin data. pgvector-derived index data is excluded and rebuilt separately.
messages.ui.emptyCanonicalWarning: If canonical data is not copied, the destination is initialized with schema metadata only and is effectively empty.
messages.ui.copyCanonicalConfirm: The current canonical data will be copied to the destination.
messages.ui.emptyCanonicalConfirm: The current canonical data will not be copied. The destination will be effectively empty after cutover.
messages.ui.pgvectorCopyUnavailable: pgvector index data cannot be copied. A new RAG index generation must be rebuilt on the destination.
messages.ui.ragRebuildQueued: A replacement RAG index generation is being rebuilt for {count} documents. Activate it after it becomes ready.
messages.ui.ragEmbeddingWaiting: The database move completed, but RAG rebuilding is waiting for Embedding ({code}). Open RAG Search settings for details and retry.
messages.ui.completedWaitingEmbedding: Migration completed. RAG rebuilding is waiting for Embedding ({code}); no vector jobs were started.
messages.ui.completedWithRagRebuild: Migration completed and RAG index rebuilding started. Reloading…
messages.ui.runStandardRagMigration: Prepare pgvector, migrate, validate, and activate
messages.ui.irreversibleWarning: After migration from {source} to {destination} succeeds, the canonical database cannot be switched back to {source}. The source database is retained but is no longer synchronized.
messages.ui.irreversibleConfirm: Migrate the canonical database from {source} to {destination}? You cannot switch it back after the migration succeeds.
messages.ui.standardRagReadyConfirm: OpenConcept will check pgvector and enable the vector extension when available. Migration will not proceed unless Standard RAG readiness is established.
messages.ui.postgresqlOnlyConfirm: Migration will not require pgvector. Standard RAG will remain unavailable until pgvector is prepared.
messages.ui.running: Migration is running. Writes are temporarily paused.
